title: Photo Medium 솔로 #032 · hourglass bombshell · 포토그램 · 손 허리 · 항구 등대 · 웨이쉰
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, mid 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, half-up half-down lavender hair — her bare skin covered from the neck down in a photogram darkroom print: crisp white silhouettes of feathers, keys, leaves, glass beads and lace laid across a deep black ground over her torso, arms and legs, soft grey halos and translucent overlaps where the objects were layered, fine silvery photographic grain, the print sitting on living skin and following every curve beneath it, covering all of her skin from the neck to the ankles and the backs of her hands, her face left unpainted and the pattern fading out at the neck. Her face, ears, neck and hands are real living skin with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs, a soft natural flush. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of polished jet-black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in glossy jet-black polish.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, and a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Russian woman with high cheekbones, light eyes and a defined jaw, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips.

Background: a sunny harbour quay of pale stone with a waist-high iron railing, mooring posts of normal height and a white lighthouse behind her, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, lit by natural light with soft shadows on the skin, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
